# Third-party notices

This folder preserves direct dependency license evidence; it does not license the research team's own code. See docs/license_audit.md for versions, source URLs, scope and obligations. OpenNTN is an independent inspected reference, not a runtime dependency or vendored implementation. Its root MIT notice and the Apache-2.0 text are both retained because inspected files carry different notices.

No third-party source code, wheelhouse, container, NYC scene, weight file or original flowchart image is distributed here. Upstream installations retain their packaged notices. A future bundled binary distribution needs an additional audit of all packaged third-party libraries.
